description: Dispensary: prepare (unsigned) using a supply you hold on your crew: items 1, 2, 3 and 6 on ONE crew (crewId), items 4 and 5 on up to 6 crews (crewIds). Items 7, 8 and 9 are spent automatically by the heists that use them.
